title: SS-07 key-less LAN monitor access
description: Copy to /etc/ss07-gateway/lan-monitor.json (root, 0644). allow_cidrs lists only the Mobocon subnet, e.g. 192.168.3.0/24. A missing, invalid or disabled file, an empty list or 0.0.0.0/0 keeps the mode off.

items.description: IPv4 network, strict form, prefix length 1-32
